headline: President Bush handed certain waiver, certification, and reporting duties assigned to the President to other federal officials.
what_it_does: This order passes some legal duties that laws give to the President over to other officials in the executive branch. Based on the title, these duties include granting waivers, making determinations and certifications, giving recommendations, and sending reports. No summary was provided, so the specific laws, duties, and officials involved are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Certain officials take on waiver, certification, and reporting tasks that the President would otherwise handle personally.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 8, 2004; the exact effective date is not stated in the provided material.
